description: Accepted findings for refcheck/run.js (see lib/accepted.js). DENY BY DEFAULT: a finding blocks the gate unless its exact key appears here. Keys are OCCURRENCE-EXACT and are printed by the gate itself — `refs:{class}:{component}@{version} {url} {{attribute}} {expected}->{actual}` — so accepting "expected 12, found 11" does NOT accept "found 10": a second baked occurrence on the same page changes the key and fails. Each entry needs a `disposition` (wont-fix | upstream | harness-limit | deferred) and a non-empty `note` saying why it is understood and why it stays; a malformed entry fails the gate. Accepted findings are still PRINTED on every run and written to build/refcheck-report.json — the point is to stop them blocking, not to hide them. A STALE entry (its finding no longer occurs) FAILS the gate, so the file cannot quietly become a record of what used to be broken. Only known conversion gaps are acceptable: `unknownContexts` and `guardFailures` can never be accepted, because they mean the gate could not judge the page at all.
